pe9:1.1: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjāya ca bhavataṇhāya ca.
pe9:1.2: tattha avijjānīvaraṇaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sattānaṃ pubbākoṭi na paññāyati.
pe9:1.3: tattha ye sattā taṇhāsaṃyojanā te ajjhosānabahulā mandavipassakā
pe9:1.4: ye pana ussannadiṭṭhikā sattā, te vipassanā bahulā. mandajjhosānā.
pe9:2.2: te pañcasu khandhesu attānaṃ samanupassanti: “rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attāna”nti.
pe9:2.4: aññehi khandhehi attānaṃ samanupassanti, tattha ussannadiṭṭhikā sattā vipassamānā khandhe ujuṃ attato samanupassanti.
pe9:2.9: iti pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭhamābhinipātā sakkāyadiṭṭhiyo pañca ucchedaṃ bhajanti. taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti,
pe9:2.10: ekamekamhi khandhe tīhi padehi pacchīmakhehi sassataṃ bhajati. aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra’nti.
pe9:2.11: ito bahiddhā te pabbajitā taṇhācaritā kāmasukhallikānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti,
pe9:2.12: tena yeva nissandena. diṭṭhicaritā attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti,
pe9:2.13: tena yeva diṭṭhisukhena ettāvatā bāhirako payogo.
pe9:3.1: tattha diṭṭhicaritā sattā ye ariyaṃdhammavinayaṃ otaranti, te dhammānusārino honti,
pe9:3.2: ye taṇhācaritā sattā ariyaṃ dhammavinayaṃ otaranti, te saddhānusārino honti.
pe9:4.1: tattha ye diṭṭhicaritā, te kāmesu dosadiṭṭhi, na ca ye kāmesu anusayā samūhatā, te attakilamathānuyogamanuyuttā viharanti.
pe9:4.3: aññe vā sāvako kāmehi natthi atthoti te ca pubbeyeva kāmehi anatthikā, iti kāme appakasirena paṭinissajanti
pe9:4.6: ye pana taṇhācaritā sattā, te kāmesu ajjhositā, tesaṃ satthā vā dhammaṃ deseti,
pe9:4.7: aññataro vā bhikkhu, kāmehi natthi attho’ti. te piyarūpaṃ dukkhena paṭinissajanti,
pe9:4.9: iti ime sabbasattā dvīsu paṭipadāsu samosaraṇaṃ gacchanti dukkhāyaṃ ca sukhāyaṃ ca.
pe9:5.1: tattha ye diṭṭhicaritā sattā, te dvidhā: mudindriyā ca tikkhindriyā ca.
pe9:5.2: tattha ye diṭṭhicaritā sattā tikkhindriyā sukhena paṭinissajanti. khippaṃ ca abhisamenti, te vuccati khippābhiññā sukhā paṭipadā’ti,
pe9:5.3: tattha ye diṭṭhicaritā sattā mudindriyā paṭhamaṃ tikkhindriyaṃ upādāya dandhataraṃ abhisamenti, te sukhena paṭinissajanti, dandhaṃ ca abhisamenti.
pe9:5.5: tattha taṇhācaritā sattā dvidhā: tikkhindriyā ca mudindriyā ca.
pe9:5.6: tattha ye taṇhācaritā sattā tikkhindriyā dukkhena paṭinissajanti, khippaṃ ca abhisamenti.
pe9:5.8: tattha ye taṇhācaritā sattā mudindriyā paṭhamaṃ tikkhindriyaṃ upādāya dandhataraṃ abhisamenti, te dukkhena paṭinissajanti, dandhaṃ ca abhisamenti,
pe9:5.11: ye hi keci nibbutā nibbādhissanti vā imāhi catūhi paṭipadāhi anaññāhi. ayaṃ paṭipadācatukkena kilesa niddisati.
pe9:5.12: yā catukkamaggena ariyadhammesu niddisitabbā. ayaṃ vuccati sīhavikkīḷito nāma nayo.
pe9:6.2: cattāro vipallāsā, upādānā, yogā, ganthā, āsavā, oghā, sallā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, agatigamanā’ti. evaṃ imāni sabbāni dasa padāti.
pe9:7.2: tattha yo ca kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro yo ca phasso āhāro, ime taṇhācaritena pahātabbā,
pe9:7.3: tattha yo ca manosañcetanāhāro yo ca viññāṇāhāro, ime diṭṭhicaritena pahātabbā.
pe9:8.1: paṭhamo āhāro paṭhamo vipallāso, dutiyo āhāro dutiyo vipallāso, tatiyo āhāro tatiyo vipallāso, catuttho āhāro catuttho vipallāso.
pe9:8.2: ime cattāro vipallāsā apañcamā ajaṭṭhā. idaṃ
pe9:9.1: tattha paṭhame vipallāse ṭhito kāme upādiyati, idaṃ kāmūpādānaṃ.
pe9:9.2: dutiye vipallāse ṭhito anāgataṃ bhavaṃ upādiyati, idaṃ sīlabbatūpādānaṃ.
pe9:9.3: tatiye vipallāse ṭhito viparītaṃ diṭṭhiṃ upādiyati, idaṃ diṭṭhūpādānaṃ.
pe9:9.4: catutthe vipallāse ṭhito khandhe attato upādiyati, idaṃ attavādūpādānaṃ.
pe9:10.1: tattha kāmūpādāne ṭhito kāme abhijjhāyati ganthati, ayaṃ abhijjhākāyagantho.
pe9:10.2: sīlabbatūpādāne ṭhito byāpādaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ byāpādākāyagantho.
pe9:10.3: diṭṭhupādāne ṭhito parāmāsaṃ ganthati, ayaṃ parāmāsakāyagantho.
pe9:10.4: attavādūpadāne ṭhito papañcanto ganthati, ayaṃ idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho.
pe9:11.4: tattha abhijjhākāyaganthena kāmāsavo, byāpādakāyaganthena bhavāsavo, parāmāsakāyaganthena diṭṭhāsavo, idaṃsaccābhinivesakāyaganthena avijjāsavo.
pe9:12.1: te cattāro āsavā vepullabhāvaṃ gatā oghā honti, tena vuccanti. oghā’ti.
pe9:12.2: tattha kāmāsavo kāmogho, bhavāsavo bhavogho, avijjāsavo avijjogho, diṭṭhāsavo, diṭṭhogho.
pe9:13.1: te cattāro oghā āsayamanupaviṭṭhā anusayasahagatā vuccanti
pe9:13.3: tattha kāmogho rāgasallaṃ, bhavogho dosasallaṃ, avijjogho mohasallaṃ, diṭṭhogho diṭṭhisallaṃ.
pe9:14.1: imehi catūhi sallehi pariyādinnaṃ viññāṇaṃ catusu dhammesu tiṭṭhati, rūpe vedanāya saññāya saṅkhāresu
pe9:14.3: tattha rāgasallena nandūpasecanaṃ rūpūpagaṃ viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhati.
pe9:14.4: dosasallena vedanūpagaṃ, mohasallena saññūpagaṃ, diṭṭhisallena nandūpasecanaṃ saṅkhārūpagaṃ viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhati.
pe9:15.1: catūhi, viññāṇaṭṭhitīhi catubbividhaṃ agatiṃ gacchanti: chandā dosā bhayā mohā.
pe9:15.2: rāgena chandā agatiṃ gacchanti, dosena dosā agatiṃ gacchati, mohena mohā agatiṃ gacchati, diṭṭhiyā bhayā agatiṃ gacchati.
pe9:15.3: iti idaṃ ca kammaṃ ime ca kilesā,
pe9:16.1: tatthimā catasso disā: kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro, ‘asubhe subha’nti vipallāso, kāmūpādānaṃ, kāmayogo, abhijjhākāyagantho, kāmāsavo, kāmogho, rāgasallaṃ rūpūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, chandā agatigamanaṃ.
pe9:17.1: phasso āhāro, ‘dukkhe sukha’nti vipallāso, sīlabbatūpādānaṃ, bhavayogo, byāpādo kāyagantho, bhavāsavo, bhavogho, dosasallaṃ, vedanūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, dosā agatigamanaṃ, ayaṃ dutiyā disā.
pe9:18.1: manosañcetanāhāro, ‘anattani attā’ti vipallāso, diṭṭhupādānaṃ, diṭṭhiyogo, parāmāsakāyagantho, diṭṭhāsavo, diṭṭhogho, diṭṭhisallaṃ, saññūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, bhayā agatigamanaṃ,
pe9:19.1: viññāṇāhāro, ‘anicce nicca’nti vipallāso, attavādūpādānaṃ, avijjāyogo, idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho, avijjāsavo, avijjogho, mohasallaṃ, saṅkhārūpagā viññāṇaṭṭhiti, mohā agatigamanaṃ ayaṃ catutthi disā.
pe9:19.2: iti imesaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ paṭhamena padena paṭhamāya disāya ālokanaṃ,
pe9:20.1: catūhi vipallāsehi akusalapakkhe disāvilokanā kilesaṃ saṃyojetvā ayaṃ akusalapakkhe disāvilokanāya bhūmi. pañcannaṃ dasannaṃ suttānaṃ yāni paṭhamāni padāni imesaṃ dhammānaṃ ko attho,
pe9:20.3: evaṃ dutiyā, evaṃ tatiyā, evaṃ catutthi.
pe9:21.1: iminā peyyālena sabbe kilesā catusu padesu pakkhipitabbā.
pe9:21.2: tato kusalapakkhe catasso paṭipadā, cattāri jhānāni, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro vihārā: dibbo brahmā ariyo āneñjo, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro acchariyā abbhutadhammo, cattāro adhiṭṭhānā, cattāro samādhayo: chandasamādhi viriyasamādhi cittasamādhi vīmaṃsāsamādhi,
pe9:21.3: cattāro dhammā sukhabhāgiyā nāññatra bojjhaṅgā nāññatra tapasā nāññatrindriya saṃvarā nāññatra sabbanissaggā cattāri appamāṇāni.
pe9:22.1: tattha dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā bhāviyamānā bahulīkariyamānā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paripūreti, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti, paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ vihāraṃ paripūreti, paṭhamo vihāro paripuṇṇe, paṭhamaṃ sammappadhānāṃ paripūreti. paṭhamaṃ sammappadhānaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ acchariyaṃ abbhutaṃ dhammaṃ paripūreti, paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo paripuṇṇo paṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ paripūreti. paṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ chandasamādhiṃ paripūreti, chandasamādhi paripuṇṇo indriyasaṃvaraṃ paripūreti. indriyasaṃvaro paripuṇṇo paṭhamaṃ mettāappamāṇaṃ paripūreti.
pe9:22.2: evaṃ yāva sabbanissaggo catutthaṃ appamāṇaṃ paripūreti.
pe9:23.1: tattha paṭhamā ca paṭipadā paṭhamaṃ ca jhānaṃ paṭhamaṃ ca satipaṭṭhānaṃ paṭhamo ca vihāro paṭhamaṃ ca appamāṇaṃ paṭhamo ca acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ ca chandasamādhi ca indriyasaṃvaro ca mettā ca appamāṇaṃ,
pe9:24.1: dutiyā ca paṭipadā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyaṃ ca satipaṭṭhānaṃ dutiyo ca vihāro dutiyaṃ ca sammappadhānaṃ dutiyo ca acchariyo abbhuto dhammo cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ cittasamādhi tapo ca karuṇā ca appamāṇaṃ. ayaṃ dutiyā disā.
pe9:25.1: tatiyā paṭipadā tatiyaṃ ca jhānaṃ tatiyaṃ ca satipaṭṭhānaṃ tatiyo ca vihāro tatiyaṃ ca sammappadhānaṃ tatiyo ca acchariyo abbhuto dhammo paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ ca viriyasamādhi ca bojjhaṅgā ca muditā ca appamāṇaṃ
pe9:26.1: catutthā ca paṭipadā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ catutthaṃ ca satipaṭṭhānaṃ catuttho ca vihāro catutthaṃ ca sammappadhānaṃ catuttho ca acchariyo abbhuto dhammo upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ ca vīmaṃsāsamādhi ca sabbanissaggo ca upekkhā appamāṇaṃ ca
pe9:27.2: cattāro ca āhārā, cattāro ca paṭipadā, cattāro ca vipallāsā, cattāro ca satipaṭṭhānaṃ, cattāri ca upādānāni, cattāri ca jhānāni, cattāro ca yogā, vihāraṃ ca, ganthā ca, sammappadhānā ca, āsavā ca acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ca, oghā ca, adhiṭṭhānāni ca, sallā ca, samādhayo, viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, cattāro ca sukhabhāgiyā dhammā, cattāri ca agatigamanāni, cattāri ca appamāṇāni iti kusalākusalānaṃ paṭipakkhavasena yojanā. ayaṃ vuccati disālokano nayo.
pe9:28.1: tassa cattāri sāmaññaphalāni pariyosānaṃ yo ca dhammo kusalākusalaniddase paṭhamo disāniddeso imassa sotāpattiphalaṃ pariyosānaṃ, dutiyaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, tatiyaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ, catutthaṃ arahattaphalaṃ.
pe9:29.2: ye ca dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca niyyanti dve puggalā, ye ca sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya khippābhiññāya ca niyyanti dve puggalā.
pe9:30.1: imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ yo puggalo sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya niyyāti, yo ca puggalo dukkhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya niyyāti,
pe9:30.3: tattha yo sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya niyyāti, ayaṃ ugghaṭitaññū,
pe9:30.4: yo pacchimo puggalo sādhāraṇo, ayaṃ vipañcitaññu
pe9:30.5: ‘yo puggalo dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya niyyāti, ayaṃ neyyo.
pe9:30.6: ime cattāro bhavitvā tīṇi honti. tattha ugghaṭitaññussa samathapubbaṅgamā vipassanā, neyyassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamo samatho, vipañcitaññussa samathavipassanā yuganaddhā.
pe9:30.7: ugghaṭitaññussa mudukā desanā, neyyassa tikkhā desanā, vipañcitaññussa tikkhamudukā desanā.
pe9:31.1: ugghaṭitaññussa adhipaññāsikkhā, neyyassa adhicittasikkhā, vipañcitaññussa adhisīlasikkhā
pe9:31.2: iti imesā puggalānaṃ catūhi paṭipadāhi niyyānaṃ.
pe9:32.1: tattha ayaṃ saṃkileso: tīṇi akusalamūlāni, tayo phassā, tisso vedanā, tayo upavicārā, tayo saṃkilesā, tayo vitakkā, tayo pariḷāhā, tīṇi saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni, tisso dukkhatāti.
pe9:33.1: tīṇi akusalamūlānīti: lobho akusalamūlaṃ, doso akusalamūlaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ.
pe9:33.2: tayo phassāti: sukhavedanīyo phasso, dukkhavedanīyo phasso, adukkhamasukhavedanīyo phasso,
pe9:33.3: tisso vedanāti: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
pe9:33.4: tayo upavicārāti: somanassopavicāro, domanassopavicāro, upekkhā pavicāro.
pe9:33.7: tayo pariḷāhāti: rāgajo, dosajo, mohajo, pariḷāho.
pe9:34.2: tividhaṃ ārammaṇaṃ, manāpikaṃ amanāpikaṃ upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ ca.
pe9:34.3: tattha manāpikena ārammaṇena lobho akusalamūlaṃ samuṭṭhahati.
pe9:34.4: iti manāpikā ārammaṇā sukhavedanīyo phasse, sukhavedanīyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjate sukhavedanā, sukhavedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjate somanassupavicāro, somanassupavicāraṃ paṭicca uppajjate rāgo rāgaṃ paṭicca uppajjate kāmavitakko, kāmavitakkaṃ. paṭicca uppajjate rāgajo pariḷāho, rāgajaṃ pariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjate uppādo saṅkhatalakkhaṇo, uppādaṃ saṅkhatakkhaṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjate vipariṇāmadukkhatā.
pe9:35.3: iti amanāpikā ārammaṇā dukkhavedanīyo phasso, dukkhavedanīyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjate dukkhavedanā dukkhavedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjate domanassūpavicāro, domanassapavicāraṃ paṭicca uppajjate doso, dosaṃ paṭicca uppajjate byāpāda vitakko, byāpādavitakkaṃ paṭicca uppajjate dosajo pariḷāho, dosajaṃ pariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjate ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ saṅkhatalakkhaṇaṃ, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ saṅkhatalakkhaṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjate dukkhadukkhatā.
pe9:36.3: iti upekkhāṭhāniyā ārammaṇā adukkhamasukhavedanīyo phasso, adukkhamasukhavedanīyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjate adukkhamasukhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjate upekkhupavicāro, upekkhupavicāraṃ paṭicca uppajjate moho, mohaṃ paṭicca uppajjate vihiṃsāvitakko, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ paṭicca uppajjate mohajo pariḷāho, mohajaṃ pariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjate vayo saṅkhatalakkhaṇaṃ, vayaṃ saṅkhatalakkhaṇaṃ, paṭicca uppajjate saṅkhāradukkhatā, iti ayaṃ tiṇṇaṃ kilesānaṃ niddeso. ayaṃ vuccate akusalapakkhe tipukkhalo nayo.
pe9:37.1: iti tīṇi akusalamūlāni na cattāri na pañcamāni, tayo phassāti: tisso vedanā yāva saṅkhāradukkhatāti yo koci akusalapakkho, sabbo so tīsu akusalamūlesu samosarati.
pe9:38.2: tīṇi kusalamūlāni, tisso paññā: sutamayī paññā cintāmayī paññā bhāvanāmayī paññā,
pe9:39.1: tattha yaṃ alobho kusalamūlaṃ, taṃ sutamayīpaññaṃ paripūreti, sutamayī paññā paripūrā savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ samādhiṃ paripūreti, savitakko savicāro samādhi paripuṇṇo adhīcittasikkhaṃ paripūreti, adhicittasikkhā paripuṇṇā samathanimittaṃ paripūreti, samathanimittaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ nekkhammavitakkaṃ paripūreti, nekkhammavitakko paripuṇṇe anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ paripūreti, anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ nekkhammupavicāraṃ paripūreti, nekkhammūpavicāro paripuṇṇo kāmesanaṃ pajahati, kāmesanappahānaṃ samādhikkhandhaṃ paripūreti.
pe9:40.1: adoso kusalamūlaṃ cintāmayīpaññaṃ paripūreti, cintāmayī paññā paripuṇṇā avitakkavicāramattaṃ samādhiṃ paripūreti,
pe9:40.2: avitakkavicāramatto samādhi paripuṇṇe adhisīlasikkhaṃ paripūreti, adhisīlasikkhā paripuṇṇā upekkhānimittaṃ paripūreti, upekkhānimittaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ avyāpādavitakkaṃ paripūreti, avyāpādavitakko paripuṇṇo aññindriyaṃ paripūreti, aññindriyaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ avyāpādūpavicāraṃ paripūreti, avyāpādūpavicāro paripuṇṇo bhavesanaṃ pajahati, bhavesanappahānaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ paripūreti.
pe9:41.1: amoho kusalamūlaṃ bhāvanamayīpaññaṃ paripūreti, bhāvanāmayīpaññā paripuṇṇā avitakkaavicāraṃ samādhiṃ paripūreti, avitakko avicāro samādhi paripuṇṇo adhipaññāsikkhaṃ paripūreti, adhipaññāsikkhā paripuṇṇā paggahanimittaṃ paripūreti, pagganimittaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ aññātāvino indriyaṃ paripūreti, aññātāvino indriyaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ avihiṃsūpavicāraṃ paripūreti, avihiṃsūpavicāro paripuṇṇo brahmacariyesanaṃ paripūreti, brahmacariyesanā paripuṇṇā paññākkhandhaṃ paripūreti.
pe9:42.1: iti ime tayo dhammā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe kusalā dhammā tīhi tikaniddesehi niddisīyanti, tīṇi vimokkhamukhāni tassa pariyosānaṃ.
pe9:42.2: tattha paṭhamena appaṇihitaṃ dutiyena suññataṃ. tatiyena animittaṃ.
pe9:42.3: ayaṃ vuccati dutiyo tipukkhalo nāma nayo.
pe9:43.1: tattha ye ime tayo puggalā: ugghaṭitaññū vipañcitaññu neyyoti.
pe9:43.2: imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ ye ca dve puggalā sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya, sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya ca niyyanti, te dve puggalā.
pe9:43.3: ye ca dve puggalā dukkhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya ca niyyanti, ime cattāro tena visesena dve bhavanti: diṭṭhicarito ca taṇhācarito ca.
pe9:43.4: ime cattāro bhavitvā tayo bhavanti, tayo bhavitvā dve bhavanti.
pe9:43.5: imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ ayaṃ saṃkileso: avijjā ca taṇhā ca, ahirikaṃ ca anottappaṃ ca, asati ca asampajaññaṃ ca, nīvaraṇāni ca saṃyojanāni ca, ajjhosānaṃ ca abhiniveso ca, ahaṅkāro ca mamaṅkāro ca, assaddhiyaṃ da dovacassaṃ ca, kosajjaṃ ca ayoniso ca manasikāro, vicikicchā ca abhijjhā ca, asaddhammasavanaṃ ca asamāpatti ca.
pe9:44.1: tattha avijjā ca ahirikaṃ ca asati ca nīvaraṇāni ca ajjhosānaṃ ca ahaṅkāro ca assaddhiyaṃ ca kosajjaṃ ca vicikicchā ca asaddhammasavanaṃ ca. ayaṃ ekā disā.
pe9:45.1: taṇhā ca anottappaṃ ca asampajaññaṃ ca saṃyojanāni ca abhiniveso ca mamaṅkāro ca devacassatā ca ayoniso manasikāro ca abhijjhā ca asamāpatti ca. ayaṃ dutiyā disā.
pe9:45.2: dasannaṃ dukānaṃ dasa padāni paṭhamāni kātabbāni.
pe9:45.3: saṅkhittena atthaṃ ñāpenti paṭipakkhe kaṇhapakkhassa sabbesaṃ dukānaṃ dasa padāni dutiyakāni. ayaṃ dutiyā disā.
pe9:46.1: iti akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ dukkhaniddeso, ayaṃ samudayo.
pe9:46.2: yaṃ taṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāvasati nāmaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca idaṃ dukkhaṃ. iti ayaṃ ca samudayo, idaṃ ca dukkhaṃ imāni dve saccāni dukkhaṃ ca samudayo ca. nandiyāvaṭṭassa nayassa paṭhamaniddeso.
pe9:47.2: samatho ca vipassanā ca, vijjā ca caraṇaṃ ca, sati ca sampajaññaṃ ca, hiri ca ottappaṃ ca ahaṅkārappahānaṃ ca mamaṅkārappahānaṃ ca, sammāvāyāmo ca yoniso ca manasikāro, sammāsati ca sammāsamādhi ca, paññā ca nibbidā ca, samāpatti ca saddhammasavanaṃ ca, somanassaṃ ca dhammānudhammapaṭipatti ca.
pe9:48.1: tattha samatho ca vijjā ca sati ca hiri ca ahaṅkārappahānaṃ ca sammāvāyāmo ca sammāsati ca paññā ca samāpatti ca somanassaṃ ca ime dhammā ekā disā.
pe9:48.2: vipassanā ca caraṇaṃ ca sampajaññaṃ ca ottappaṃ ca mamaṅkārappahānaṃ ca yoniso manasikāro ca sammāsamādhi ca nibbidā ca saddhammasavanaṃ ca dhammānudhammapaṭipatti ca ayaṃ dutiyā disā.
pe9:48.3: iti kusalapakkhe ca akusalapakkhe ca nandiyāvaṭṭassa pana nayassa catasso disā.
pe9:49.1: tāsu yāni akusalapakkhassa paṭhamāni padāni akusalāni kusalehi pahānaṃ gacchanti, tāni kusalapakkhe dutiyehi dutiyehi padehi pahānaṃ gacchanti,
pe9:49.2: tesaṃ pahānā rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, yāni akusalapakkhassa dutiyāni akusalapadāni pahānaṃ gacchanti, tāni kusalapakkhassa paṭhamehi padehi pahānaṃ gacchanti.
pe9:49.4: imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ nayānaṃ paṭhamo nayo sīhavikkīḷito nāma.
pe9:49.5: aṭṭha padāni cattāri ca kusalāni cattāri ca akusalāni imāni aṭṭha padāni mūlapadāni, atthanayena dutiyo tipukkhalo.
pe9:49.6: so chahi dhammehi neti, kusalamūlāni ca neti, akusalamūlāni ca. iti imāni cha padāni purimakāni ca aṭṭha mūlapadāni imāni cuddasa padāni aṭṭhārasannaṃ mūlapadānaṃ.
pe9:49.7: tattha yo pacchimako nayo nandiyāvaṭṭo so catūhi dhammehi neti
pe9:49.8: avijjāya ca taṇhāya ca samathena ca vipassanāya ca. ime cattāro dhammā, imāni aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni tīsu nayesu niddiṭṭhāni.
pe9:50.1: tattha yāni nava padāni kusalāni, tattha sabbaṃ kusalaṃ samosarati.
pe9:50.2: tesaṃ ca navannaṃ padānaṃ cattāri padāni sīhavikkīḷītanaye tīṇi kipukkhale dve nandiyāvaṭṭe. kusalassa pakkhā.
pe9:50.3: tattha yāni nava padāni kusalāni kattha sabbaṃ kusalaṃ yujjati.
pe9:50.4: tattha sīhavikkīḷite naye cattāri padāni, tīṇi tipukkhale, dve nandiyāvaṭṭe. imāni nava padāni kusalāni niddiṭṭhāni.
pe9:51.1: tattha yāni nandiyāvaṭṭe naye cattāri padāni, tattha aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni, samosaranti,
pe9:51.2: yathā kathaṃ: samatho ca alobho ca adoso ca asubhasaññā ca dukkhasaññā ca imāni kusalapakkhe pañca padāni samathaṃ bhajanti.
pe9:51.3: vipassanā ca amoho ca aniccasaññā ca anattasaññā ca imāni cattāri padāni vipassanaṃ bhajanti.
pe9:51.4: imāni nava padāni kusalāni dvīsu padesu yojitāni. tattha akusalapakkhe navannaṃ akusalapadānaṃ yā ca taṇhā yo ca lobho yo ca doso yā ca subhasaññā yā ca sukhasaññā, imāni pañca padāni taṇhaṃ bhajanti.
pe9:51.5: yā ca avijjā yo ca moho yā ca niccasaññā yā ca attasaññā, imāni cattāri padāni avijjaṃ bhajanti.
pe9:51.7: iti tayo nayā ekaṃ nayaṃ na paviṭṭhā.
pe9:52.1: kathaṃ aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni tipukkhale naye yujjanti:
pe9:52.2: navannaṃ padānaṃ kusalānaṃ vipassanā ca amoho ca aniccasaññā ca anattasaññā ca imāni cattāri padāni.
pe9:52.3: amoho (?) ca samatho ca alobho ca asubhasaññā ca imāni cattāri padāni.
pe9:52.4: lobho ca doso ca evaṃ imāni nava padāni tīsu kusalesu yojetabbāni.
pe9:52.5: tattha navannaṃ padānaṃ akusalānaṃ taṇhā ca lobho ca subhasaññā ca sukhasaññā ca imāni cattāri padāni lobho akusalamūlānaṃ.
pe9:52.6: avijjā ca moho ca niccasaññā ca attasaññā ca ayaṃ moho, doso ayaṃ doso. ye ca imāni nava padāni tīsu akusalesu yojitāni,
pe9:52.7: evaṃ aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni, kusalesu ca yojetvā tipukkhalena nayena niddisitabbāni.
pe9:53.1: kathaṃ aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni sīhavikkīḷite naye yujjanti:
pe9:53.2: taṇhā ca subhasaññā ca ayaṃ paṭhamo vipallāso.
pe9:53.3: lobho ca sukhasaññā ca ayaṃ dutiyo vipallāso.
pe9:53.4: avijjā ca niccasaññā ca ayaṃ tatiyo vipallāso.
pe9:53.5: moho ca attasaññā ca ayaṃ catuttho vipallāso.
pe9:53.6: iti nava padāni akusalamūlāni catusu padesu yojitāni.
pe9:53.7: tattha navannaṃ mūlapadānaṃ kusalānaṃ samatho ca asubhasaññā ca idaṃ paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe9:53.8: alobho ca dukkhasaññā ca idaṃ dutiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe9:53.9: vipassanā ca aniccasaññā ca, idaṃ tatiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe9:53.10: amoho ca anattasaññā ca idaṃ catutthaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe9:53.12: imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ nayānaṃ yā bhūmi yo rāgo ca yo doso ca ekaṃ nayaṃ pavisati.
pe9:53.13: ekassa nayassa akusale vā dhamme kusale vā dhamme viññāte paṭipakkho anvesitabbo. paṭipakkhe anvesitvā yo nayo niddisitabbo, tamhi naye niddiṭṭhe.
pe9:53.14: yathā ekamhi naye sabbe nayā paviṭṭhā tathā niddisitabbā.
pe9:53.15: ekamhi ca naye aṭṭhārasa mūlapadāni paviṭṭhāni, tamhi dhamme viññāte sabbe dhammā viññātā honti.
pe9:53.16: imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ nayānaṃ sīhavikkīḷitanayassa cattāri phalāni pariyosānaṃ.
pe9:53.17: paṭhamāya disāya paṭhamaṃ phalaṃ, dutiyāya disāya dutiyaṃ phalaṃ, tatiyāya disāya tatiyaṃ phalaṃ, catutthāya disāya catutthaṃ phalaṃ.
pe9:53.19: paṭhamāya disāya appaṇihitaṃ, dutiyāya disāya suññataṃ, tatiyāya disāya animittaṃ.
pe9:53.20: nandiyāvaṭṭassa nayassa rāgavirāgā cetovimutti avijjāvirāgā ca paññāvimutti pariyosānaṃ.
pe9:53.21: paṭhamāya disāya rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, dutiyāya disāya avijjāvirāgā paññā vimutti.
pe9:53.22: ime tayo nayā, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ nayānaṃ aṭṭhārasannaṃ mūlapadānaṃ ālokanā, ayaṃ vuccati disālocano nayo.
pe9:53.23: āloketvāna jānāti ‘ayaṃ dhammo imaṃ dhammaṃ bhajatī’ti sammāyojanā.
pe9:53.24: kusalapakkhe akusalapakkhe ca. ayaṃ nayo aṃkuso nāma.
pe9:64.1: yāni catukkāni akusalāni kusalāni ca sīhavikkīḷite naye niddiṭṭhāni, tikāni kusalāni ca akusalāni ca tipukkhale naye niddiṭṭhāni, dukāni kusalāni ca akusalāni ca nandiyāvaṭṭe naye niddiṭṭhāni,
pe9:64.2: yesu dvīsu dhammesu kusalesu (?) so attho tikesu vibhajjamānassa bhavabhūmi. atha ca sabbo ca attho tīhi byañjanehi niddisati.
pe9:64.4: yo attho catūhi padehi aṭṭhavīsatibhāgehi natthi bhūmi niddisituṃ. avacarantova catūhi padehi niddisati.
pe9:64.5: iti yaṃ yathā, niddiṭṭhassa avikosanā (?) idaṃ pamāṇaṃ.
pe9:64.6: yathā sabbe samādhayo tīsu samādhisu pariyesitabbā, savitakkasavicāre avitakkavicāramatte avitakkaavicāre, idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, natthi catuttho samādhi.
pe9:64.7: tathā tisso paññā, cintāmayī sutamayī bhāvanāmayī, sabābāsu paññāsu niddisanti natthi catutthi paññā, na cintāmayī na sutamayī na bhāvanāmayī paññā. nāssa natthi imesaṃ dhammānaṃ yā avikkhepanā, idaṃ vuccati pamāṇanti.
